variations.name: Reference-front view — travel_accessory_v11

variations.detail: 6–8s: Highlight only an actual pictured edge, fastening, finish or supplied part where present. Do not invent compatibility, capacity, travel security, hidden pockets, durability or use-case demonstration.

variations.audio: Soft unobtrusive instrumental; no invented zips, fabric rustles, voiceover promises or distracting sound effects.
